reading.action: Floor 1: practice — deliberately recreate the turn-17 panic discharge as a CONTROLLED outward ember wave, targeted at the wall rubble
reading.result: SOLID SUCCESS (margin 10). After a couple of fizzles (calm lacks the panic trigger), he reframes it as a LETTING-GO not a push, and meters a measured part of the heat (key insight: scale it, don't empty himself). A short hard ember pulse crosses to the rubble — scorch-mark, dust jumping. NEW SKILL EMERGED by deed: Ember Burst (area discharge), Novice (seeded 4), nascent. Distinct from Ember Channel (focused conduction) — different application, separate ladder entry; skillBonus +0 at Novice. Controlled = cheap, NO backlash: Focus 104->80 (-24). HP/Stamina unchanged. Ember Affinity +1 (heat-matched channel event) -> 7. System fires SKILL EMERGED panel. Ember Channel unchanged (Journeyman 14).
